isMasterwork.label: Is Masterwork
isMasterwork.hint: Whether this weapon is of masterwork quality, providing a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

weaponType.label: Weapon Type
weaponType.hint: The general type of this weapon, which may affect which characters can use it and how it interacts with certain effects.

weaponSubtype.label: Weapon Subtype
weaponSubtype.hint: The specific subtype of this weapon, which may affect its properties and usage.

weaponBaseType.label: Base Type
weaponBaseType.hint: The base type of this weapon, which may affect its characteristics and interactions.

damageRoll.label: Damage Roll
damageRoll.hint: The roll used to determine the damage dealt by this weapon.

damageType.label: Damage Type
damageType.hint: The type of damage this weapon deals, which may affect resistances and vulnerabilities.

critRange.label: Critical Range
critRange.hint: The range of dice rolls that result in a critical hit.

critMultiplier.label: Critical Multiplier
critMultiplier.hint: The multiplier applied to damage on a critical hit.

rangeIncrement.label: Range Increment
rangeIncrement.hint: The distance at which the weapon's range increment applies.

attackFormula.label: Attack Formula Override
attackFormula.hint: Optional override formula for the attack roll of this weapon.

damageFormula.label: Damage Formula Override
damageFormula.hint: Optional override formula for the damage roll of this weapon.

attackNotes.label: Attack Notes
attackNotes.hint: Notes or flavor text related to attacks with this weapon.

damageNotes.label: Damage Notes
damageNotes.hint: Notes or flavor text related to damage from this weapon.
